note: Voiceover for SlateFilm. `f` is the frame the line starts on (30fps). Written to sit BESIDE the on-screen type, not to read it aloud — the captions state facts, the voice makes the argument. Low, calm, male; close-mic; unhurried.

lines.text: It works for a minute. You read none of it.
Somewhere in there, it touched auth.
So you go looking. Terminal, editor, diff, the old spec.
And the change that broke it has already scrolled away.
Slate puts the answer where you are already looking.
Every write lands on the left. The right half is already the thing it wrote.
No model, no prompt. Sixty lines of Rust decide.
Nothing to look for. It is already there.
Twelve megabytes. No account. No telemetry.
Slate. The terminal that shows its work.
